{{Quote|Echo Station 3-T-8. We have spotted Imperial walkers.|Sergeant Major Trey Callum|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Trey Callum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]] of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel Alliance Special Forces]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Formerly a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial officer corps]], Callum defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] to fight the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the overall leadership of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]], Callum commanded a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Special forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] at [[Outpost Beta/Legends|Outpost Beta]] on the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] defensive perimeter during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Callum was the first to report to Echo Base the presence of Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] advancing toward the base during the opening stages of the battle, and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the first barrage of AT-AT [[Laser cannon/Legends|blasterfire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Rogue Leader&hellip;Incoming! Point Zero Three.|Trey Callum warns Luke Skywalker of the invading AT-AT walkers|<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Trey Callum, a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies" /> was originally a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial officer corps]], but he defected from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to join the revolutionary [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CSWE-Trey Callum" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Callum served as a [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]] with [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Who's Who" /><ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

[[File:Callum.png|thumb|left|290px|Trey Callum reports the presence of Imperial All Terrain Assault Transports.]]
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Callum was one of the battle-hardened field [[Officer/Legends|officers]] under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> tasked with [[Evac Rearguard Action 101|delaying]] the advance of the Imperial invasion [[Blizzard Force/Legends|force]] long enough to buy sufficient [[Time/Legends|time]] for the base's personnel and equipment to evacuate the planet.<ref name="GG3" /> Callum was in charge of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Special forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] at [[Outpost Beta/Legends|Outpost Beta]],<ref name="CSWE-Trey Callum" /> the outermost sentry post of Echo Base's external defensive perimeter.<ref name="GG3" />

While entrenched near [[Echo Station 5-T-7]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> where he was preparing his squad for in-close fighting,<ref name="ESB novel" /><ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Callum received a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] call from [[Echo Station 3-T-8/Legends|Echo Station 3-T-8]], notifying him that forward [[Scout/Legends|scout]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Maren Kelsome]]<ref name="GG3" /> had spotted Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], and was asked to verify. Although the thundering footfalls of the walkers was enough to tell him that the Imperial invasion force was close,<ref name="Who's Who" /> with a shock of recognition, Callum confirmed the presence of around a dozen approaching [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]<ref name="ESB novel" /> through his [[Model TD2.3 electrobinoculars/Legends|TD2.3 electrobinoculars]].<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Callum reported back to Station 3-T-8 to verify his visual confirmation of the AT-ATs, which also broadcast throughout Echo Base, first announcing the extent of the Imperial ground force.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Callum also issued a comlink warning to [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], in command of Echo Base's [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]], of the approaching walkers.<ref name="ESB novel" /> Soon after reporting his sighting, however, Callum was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the opening barrage of AT-AT [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Although [[Troop/Legends|troops]] rushed to his aid after Callum was gunned down, they were unable to save him, as too much of his [[Blood/Legends|blood]] had been lost, leaving a [[Color/Legends|red]] stain among Hoth's snow.<ref name="ESB novel" />

==Personality and traits==
Trey Callum, like many Rebel specialists, defected from the Imperial Military. He was an expert at stretching the Alliance's meager resources,<ref name="Hoth Limited-Echo Base Trooper Officer">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Echo Base Trooper Officer}}</ref> particularly at rationing supplies and making the most of the Alliance's small weapons stockpile.<ref name="CSWE-Trey Callum" /> He had light skin.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Hoth, Callum wore the standard [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather armor]] of the Echo Base field [[Troop/Legends|troops]], including the [[Armor/Legends|set's]] [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|headgear]], [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|anti-glare goggles]], [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]], padded vest, [[thermal flak jacket]], gloves,<ref name="ESB" /> leggings, boots,<ref name="Star Wars 40">[[Star Wars (1977) 40|''Star Wars'' (1977) 40]]</ref> and [[Alliance Cold Weather Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. He utilized TD2.3 [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] and a wrist comlink to identify and report, respectively, the presence of AT-AT walkers.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
[[File:BobAnderson.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Swordmaster and Darth Vader fight double Bob Anderson played Trey Callum in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
Trey Callum appears in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as the Rebel trench officer who first reports to Echo Base the sighting of AT-ATs during the opening stages of the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="ESB" /> Although uncredited, stuntman and swordmaster [[Bob Anderson]] portrayed the character in the film.<ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=344|text=My Bob Anderson Starwars Autograph|author=Oldbury, Dave Louis|date=2011-06-21|work=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 2">{{WebCite|url=http://www.let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=862|text=My Bob Anderson Starwars Autograph|author=Oldbury, Dave Louis|date=2011-08-27|work=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 3">{{WebCite|url=http://www.let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=863|text=My Bob Anderson Starwars Autograph|author=Oldbury, Dave Louis|date=2011-08-27|work=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|nobackup=1}}</ref> Anderson is best known for his role as the [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] fight double for actor [[David Prowse]] in [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duels]] in both ''The Empire Strikes Back'' and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Star Wars Insider 132">{{InsiderCite|132|Launchpad}}</ref>

The character was first identified by name on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/echobasetrooperofficer.gif "Echo Base Trooper Officer" card] from the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Hoth Limited-Echo Base Trooper Officer" /> The [[February]] [[2004]] article ''[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth]]'', appearing in [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]], expanded on Callum's brief role at the Battle of Hoth, explaining the specifics of his inclusion in a chain of Rebel comlink calls that confirms the presence of Imperial walkers. The article was also the first source to confirm Callum's death in the battle.<ref name="Who's Who" />

Callum is also featured in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', among its [[2008]] Battle of Hoth instance, in which players recreate the iconic battle from ''The Empire Strikes Back''. The character appears briefly in a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] window, reciting his line from the film. ''Star Wars Galaxies'' depicts Callum as wearing his [[Clothing/Legends|uniform's]] cold-weather headgear in a manner that completely covers his face, a departure from his presentation in the film.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies" />

===Character confusion===
Trey Callum should not be confused with the character of Maren Kelsome, whom the 1996 second edition of the [[West End Games]] sourcebook [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'']] identifies as the forward Rebel scout who reports to Echo Station 3-T-8 the first sighting of AT-ATs, which is then reported to Callum.<ref name="Who's Who" /><ref name="GG3" /><ref name="StarWars.com Message Boards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1545#16926420|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-09-26|time=5:34 PM|quote='''What Rebel Echo Base trooper spoke the line 'Echo Station 3-T-8. We've spotted Imperial Walkers'?''' Trey Callum.}}</ref>

Further confusion may arise over Callum's possible appearance in [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]] and the radio drama script, published in ''[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization]]''. During the film scene in which the Rebels first spot the AT-ATs on Hoth, the radio drama is alternatively set within the Echo Base command center, and the reports are heard over comlink. The command center receives a call directly from Echo Station 3-T-8, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] subsequently opens up communication with a young [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], identified only as "Outpost Beta," who nervously describes the giant size of the walkers, which Rieekan in turn confirms are AT-ATs.<ref name="Fire and Ice">{{ESBRadio|Fire and Ice}}</ref><ref name="ESB NPR">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> This young soldier is, in fact, Maren Kelsome, as confirmed by ''Galaxy Guide 3'',<ref name="GG3" /> and, again, should not be confused with Callum, who is the third link in the chain of comlink calls from Kelsome and Echo Station 3-T-8.<ref name="Who's Who" />

Likewise, Callum should not be confused with a character narrative appearing in "Chapter Six: Ground Combat" from the [[1990]] [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook|first edition]] and [[1994]] second edition of the West End Games [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'']]. The chapter introduction describes how "the advance scout on Echo Base's [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]] [who was] the first to see the walkers" goes on to rescue a downed snowspeeder [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] once the last AT-AT passes his position.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, 1st">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, 2nd">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> This description may also seem to correspond to Maren Kelsome; however, any connection to either character represents a stark [[Canon|continuity]] inconsistency, since both Callum and Kelsome are dead by this point in the battle.<ref name="Who's Who" /><ref name="GG3" />

===Inconsistencies===
[[File:CallumHollis.jpg|thumb|left|280px|''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' identifies the foreground Rebel soldier as both Trey Callum and Reyé Hollis.]]
The [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back Cine-Manga|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' PhotoComic]], a 2008 [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] adaptation using still images from the film, includes Trey Callum's scene announcing the approaching AT-AT walkers. However, the comic attributes the line "Imperial walkers on the north ridge" to Callum,<ref name="ESB PhotoComic">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back Cine-Manga|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' Cine-Manga]]</ref> which is actually spoken in the film by a public address voice in response to Callum's report.<ref name="ESB" /> Similarly, the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/walkersighting.gif "Walker Sighting" card] from the ''Hoth Limited'' ''SWCCG'' expansion set includes the quote "Echo station, 3TA. We have spotted Imperial walkers," a corruption of Callum's actual spoken line from the film.<ref name="Hoth Limited-Walker Sighting">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Walker Sighting}}</ref>

''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in 2008, uses the same production photo of a Hoth Rebel soldier from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to illustrate both Trey Callum and Hoth soldier [[Reyé Hollis/Legends|Reyé Hollis]].<ref name="CSWE-Callum">{{CSWECite|I|105|Callum, Trey}} &ndash; Accompanying character photo</ref><ref name="CSWE-Hollis">{{CSWECite|II|50|Hollis, Sergeant Reyé}} &ndash; Accompanying character photo</ref> However, the actor in the production photo is visibly different from stuntman Bob Anderson, who plays Callum in the film,<ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 1" /><ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 2" /><ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 3" /> and does not clearly correspond to the Hollis character either. Therefore, this article avoids making a judgment as to which character the production photo's actor is intended to be.

While ''Who's Who in Echo Base'',<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]],<ref name="ESB novel" /> and ''The Empire Strikes Back'' film script<ref name="ESB Notebook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Notebook]]''</ref><ref name="Annotated Screenplays">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref><ref name="Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> identify Callum as using electrobinoculars&mdash;specifically, Model TD2.3 electrobinoculars, as identified by the 2004 reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''<ref name="NEGWT" />&mdash;to visually confirm the approaching line of AT-AT walkers,<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]] claims Callum uses [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]],<ref name="ESB junior">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> a less expensive and more resilient visual-enhancement device.<ref name="NEGWT" />

The [[2001]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'' explains that Outpost Beta troops are in command of the Echo Base [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] during the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="Rogue Squadron II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> which would seem to imply that Callum, who is in charge of a squad of soldiers at Outpost Beta, is therefore in charge of the ion cannon in some form.<ref name="CSWE-Trey Callum" /> However, a detailed Battle of Hoth field map illustration in ''Galaxy Guide 3'' shows that Outpost Beta is the most distant Echo Base perimeter station from the ion cannon.<ref name="GG3" />

===Non-canon biography===
[[File:MustachedMan.png|thumb|right|200px|Callum's mustachioed counterpart]]
The Trey Callum character inspired non-canon versions of the character's corresponding film scene in the [[2006]] video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'' and its accompanying subsequent release, ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''. The games, which offer a humorous retelling of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' saga, feature a lead-in cutscene to the Battle of Hoth levels depicting a mustachioed Rebel officer, corresponding to Callum's role in the film, who keeps a lookout on the Echo Base defensive perimeter for approaching Imperial forces. After spotting AT-AT walkers through his electrobinoculars, the character pulls out a heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and opens fire on the Imperial machines. The AT-ATs return fire and promptly blow the character away.<ref name="LEGO II">''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref><ref name="LEGO Complete Saga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
